About
J D Birla Institute Department of Management, Kolkata
J.D. Birla Institute- Department of Management, Kolkata was established in the year 1962. It is a well-known educational institution located in the central part of Kolkata, West Bengal. This coed institute is an affiliated college offering decent education in the field of management. Having 11 faculty members, the institute focuses on offering a sound learning environment for future business executives. The Department of Management is located at 1 Moira Street, Kolkata - 700017, which makes students from almost every part of the city reach quite easily.
The Institute has several facilities to help the students in their learning process: The LRC or Learning Resource Centre of the institute functions like a library facility with lots of reference books on professional journals, magazines, and newspapers on different aspects of management studies. There are 46 computers present in the LRC, which is fitted with internet access.
This is used by the students for carrying on research work and study. Along with these, the institute has a medical facility with a first-aid centre, sports facility, and a well-equipped cafeteria for all the students and staff. The campus is fully WiFi enabled that enables smooth connectivity for academic purposes. Events and seminars are allowed in the auditorium present within the campus while the departmental laboratories are useful for practical learning. J.D. Birla Institute - Department of Management at present offers only one full-time course: Bachelor of Business Administration.

J D Birla Institute Department of Management, Kolkata
Admission
J.D. Birla Institute, Department of Management, is a recognised institution, placed right in the heart of Kolkata, West Bengal. The institute is famous for imparting excellent education in the field of management. Being an affiliated college, its focus is to provide an environment conducive to learning for aspirants in the field of business. J.D. Birla Institute admission process is tailored for admission of motivated and competent candidates to the management programme.
J.D. Birla Institute, Department of Management
mainly runs the Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) programme, and its admission cycle in the broader sense bears down to the period coinciding with the academic year, which usually is somewhere around the months of July or August.  Due to high competitiveness of management education, more so than likely, the institutes conduct their own admission tests or interviews for assessing candidates on the aptitude and fit for the BBA programme.
J.D. Birla Institute, Department of Management Application Process
Visit the official website of J.D. Birla Institute, Department of Management.
Navigate to admissions or apply section on the university website.
Download the application form or register for an online application.
Fill out the application form with correct personal and academic information.
Upload required documents.
Pay the application fee (amount to be confirmed from the institute's website).
Submit the completely filled application form and all required documents.
Ordinary dates for entrance exams, interviews, or counseling sessions should be marked and kept track on.
Attend all admission tests or interviews as notified by the institute.
Check the results and an eventual merit list on the institute's website or notice board.
If selected, carry out all the formalities of admission, including document checking and fee payment.
J.D. Birla Institute, Department of Management BBA Admission Process
The
BBA
programming at J.D. Birla Institute, Department of Management, is the chief course put forward by the institute. The full-time BBA has been an undergraduate study programme imparting basic knowledge of business and management principles. The total BBA fees are Rs. 539,850 which stands for the full course duration.
The normal eligibility for the BBA:
Completion of education up to 12 years or 10+2 from a recognised Educational Board-or- its Equivalent
A minimum percentage of marks in the qualifying examination (to be confirmed from the institute
Proficiency in English-language (which is likely the medium of instruction)
Admission in BBA is through the following stages:
Submission of an application form (likely available on the institute's website)
Screening of applications based on academic performance
Possible entrance test or aptitude assessment
Interview round for shortlisted candidates
Final decision taken based on performance in academics, entrance tests (if any), and interview.
J.D. Birla Institute, Department of Management Documents Required
Passport size photograph
Mark sheets of 10th and 12th
School leaving certificate
Character certificate
Any other certificates regarding extracurricular activities or achievements
Students must complete the document submission to confirm their admission seat.
